    AI Overview
    No, Cameron Young has not won the Masters. As of the conclusion of the 2026 Masters on April 12, 2026, he has not won a major championship. Young finished tied for third in the 2026 Masters, two shots behind winner Rory McIlroy, after entering the final round in a tie for the lead. 
    Key 2026 Masters Details: 
    • Final Result: Finished tied for 3rd (10-under 278).
    • Performance: Shot a 7-under 65 in the third round to tie for the lead with Rory McIlroy.
    • Previous Best: Tied for 7th in 2023. 
    His best major finish remains a runner-up spot at the 2022 Open Championship.

    golfoncbs · Instagram
    PGA Tour broadcaster
    Cameron Young’s career has been a perfect natural progression. He qualified for the Korn Ferry Tour in 2020, winning back to back events in 2021 to earn a PGA Tour card for the 2021/22 season. He then was a consistent contender to win majors and PGA Tour events, finishing 3rd at the PGA and 2nd at The Open, but despite so many impressive performances, couldn’t quite get across the line. Then after 4 years on the PGA Tour and many near misses, he finally won the Wyndham at the end of the 2025 season for his breakthrough victory. That gave him confidence to be the standout US performer in the Ryder Cup at Bethpage and win The Players Championship a few weeks ago. Now he’s just shot a bogey free 65 at the Masters to be tied for the lead with Rory McIlroy, looking for his first major championship victory tomorrow. If he does, he will be the third Players Champion in a row to then go on and win the Masters. Can he do it? @themasters
